name: software-architect
description: Bootstraps repository design constraints, clarifies PRDs, designs against existing code, prepares tasks for human evaluation and implements confirmed tasks with explicit authorization and verification.

displayDescription.en: Bootstraps repository constraints, delivers code-grounded designs and human-reviewed tasks, then implements confirmed tasks only when explicitly authorized.
displayDescription.zh: 自动初始化仓库规范，再结合需求和代码输出设计与任务，人工确认后按授权开发和验证。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请根据我提供的 PRD、原型及代码仓库，先审查需求并提出需产品补充的问题，确认后按各仓库规范生成带需求编号的详细研发设计，保存到对应仓库；本次不编写业务代码。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Review my PRD, prototype and repositories, clarify blocking questions first, then produce requirement-numbered detailed designs in each repository following its standards. Do not implement business code.

quickPrompts.zh: 请根据我提供的 PRD、原型及代码仓库，先审查需求并提出需产品补充的问题，确认后按各仓库规范生成带需求编号的详细研发设计，保存到对应仓库；本次不编写业务代码。
quickPrompts.en: Review my PRD, prototype and repositories, clarify blocking questions first, then produce requirement-numbered detailed designs in each repository following its standards. Do not implement business code.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据我的评估意见调整 tasks 和相关设计，先不要开发
quickPrompts.en: Revise tasks and related designs from my review feedback without implementing

quickPrompts.zh: 检查任务确认版本和依赖，按我明确授权的任务范围开发并验证
quickPrompts.en: Check task approval and dependencies, then implement and verify the explicitly authorized scope

quickPrompts.zh: 先检查 PRD 和现有代码，列出需要产品或研发确认的问题
quickPrompts.en: Review the PRD and existing code, then list questions for product and engineering

quickPrompts.zh: 依据已确认需求和各仓库规范，分仓库输出详细研发设计
quickPrompts.en: Deliver detailed per-repository designs from confirmed requirements and repository standards

quickPrompts.zh: 我们正在开发大型软件系统,需要整体架构设计和长期发展规划,请软件架构师帮我们设计可扩展的系统架构。
quickPrompts.en: We are developing a large-scale software system and need overall architecture design and long-term development planning. Please, Software Architect, help us design a scalable system architecture.

quickPrompts.zh: 制定架构演进和重构路线图
quickPrompts.en: Develop architecture evolution and refactoring roadmap

quickPrompts.zh: 评审架构方案并输出设计文档
quickPrompts.en: Review architecture plans and produce design documents
